verdict.rationale: Cloudflare AI Gateway documents request retry and fallback configuration for transient provider errors, including triggering fallback providers on request errors or timeouts, and response headers indicating which step/model handled the request. This directly satisfies the retry-on-transient-error story. Missing for 10: no independent/hands-on corroboration of retry behavior in practice, and no detail on configurable retry counts/backoff strategies beyond fallback chaining.
